verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no official Glama SDK package in any language. The closest items are developer building blocks: an OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec for the directory API, published 'for generating a client', and per-endpoint cURL/JavaScript/Python/PHP code samples in the hosted reference. Neither is a first-party SDK, so neither earns credit under the partial-credit boundary.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Glama publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for its MCP directory API
alongside cURL/JavaScript/Python/PHP samples and full schemas
